preamble.summary: Proverbs is sparsely attested at Qumran in just two small Cave 4 manuscripts. Coverage is fragmentary; both witnesses agree with MT in the preserved passages. The major text-critical question — the substantial LXX-vs-MT differences in Proverbs (additions, reordering, theological rewriting) — is not directly resolved by the DSS evidence.
preamble.notable_variants: No significant content variants in the preserved fragments. The DSS does not illuminate the LXX's free Proverbs translation tradition.
preamble.coverage_assessment: fragmentary; ~30 verses attested across the listed manuscripts.
